source_text: Economic modeling in HIV-endemic regions substantiates these benefits, estimating that circumcision averts treatment costs for infections at ratios exceeding 10:1, with voluntary medical male circumcision deemed cost-saving in 62% of sub-Saharan African settings based on incidence data from 2010-2020.
